title: Cross-Examine: Execution-Grounded Verification for AI-Authored Python Changes
description: Cross-Examine is an independent verification harness for AI-authored Python changes. It captures base behavior, replays the same inputs against a changed revision, searches bounded adversarial inputs, and computes verdicts from executed evidence rather than model assertions. The software is proprietary and is not distributed under an open-source license.
